title: Garmin Run Malaysia 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Garmin Run Malaysia review: more than 13,000 runners at Dataran Putrajaya in November 2025, a route past the city's landmarks and lakes. What to expect in 2026.
dek: Garmin's Malaysian race drew more than 13,000 runners to Putrajaya in November 2025, more than the year before. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: Garmin Run Malaysia is one of the biggest stops on Garmin's Asia series. The 2025 edition, in Putrajaya in November, drew more than 13,000 runners, more than the year before [1]. Runners gathered at Dataran Putrajaya at dawn for a route past the city's architectural landmarks, green avenues and lakes, with a half marathon and a 10 km [1]. The race village had interactive zones, hydration stations and live entertainment [1]. If you want a big, well-run brand race in the Klang Valley on a scenic route, it is a good one. The only report available is one publication's, and it is warm.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: More than 13,000 runners took part at Dataran Putrajaya, from elite athletes to weekend joggers [1]. The event, organised by Garmin Malaysia, exceeded the previous year's numbers [1].
The theme was From Zero to Hero, and the race offered a half marathon and a 10 km [1].

sections.heading: The Route
paragraphs: The route wound through Putrajaya's architectural landmarks and green avenues, and past its lakes [1]. SportPlus described it as offering both beauty and challenge [1].
After the race there was a race village with interactive zones, hydration stations and live entertainment [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: If you want a big half marathon or 10 km near Kuala Lumpur with a scenic route, yes. The field of 13,000 gives it real atmosphere.
The report on 2025 reads like a celebration more than a review, and it gives few details on results or course profile, so check the route and timing before you race it for a time.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.
